title: Anti-inflammatory activity of an IL-6 missense variant against crystal-induced inflammatory response.
authors: Li, Yang; Leng, Jing; Wen, Na; Han, Huiying; Wang, Haozhen; Song, Zhijie; Liu, Qing; Lu, Xiuli; Gao, Bing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IL-6错义变异对晶体诱导炎症的抑制作用，虽用分子动力学模拟分析IL-6/IL-6R/gp130复合物结构变化，但核心是蛋白-蛋白受体结合而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) has an important modulator effect on inflammation and immunity and is involved in the progression of nephrolithiasis (kidney stone). However, whether IL-6 genetic variants affect the pathogenesis of kidney stones remains unclear. The present study conducted a combined investigation of candidate gene-driven screening and systematic screening on whole exome sequencing data from 28 patients of calcium oxalate stones, identifying a non-synonymous single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) rs13306435 in IL-6 as a candidate research locus, which was further validated using HRM genotyping in an expanded cohort comprising 241 cases and 229 healthy subjects. Western blotting and qRT-PCR were used to assess the effects of this variant on crystal-induced inflammation, while molecular dynamics simulation was employed to analyze structural alterations in the receptor binding complex. In individuals aged </=40 years, the A allele of rs13306435 was nominally associated with a reduced risk of stone formation, but no association was observed for the whole population. This missense variant causes an aspartate-to-glutamate substitution (D/E), inhibiting calcium oxalate monohydrate (COM)-triggered JAK2/STAT3 activation and inflammatory responses. However, it decreased the binding energy of IL-6/IL-6R/gp130 complex by increasing hydrogen bonds and salt brigdge at remote interfaces, suggesting that enhanced receptor binding does not necessarily translate to increased downstream signaling. Although this variant is not associated with general stone susceptibility, it exhibits notable anti-inflammatory activity by attenuating COM-induced JAK2/STAT3 activation and may influence the progression of stones through this pathway. These findings provide new insights into the role of anti-inflammatory mechanisms in nephrolithiasis.
abstract_zh: 白细胞介素-6（IL-6）在炎症和免疫中具有重要的调节作用，并参与肾结石（nephrolithiasis）的进展。然而，IL-6基因变异是否影响肾结石的发病机制仍不清楚。本研究对28例草酸钙结石患者的全外显子组测序数据进行了候选基因驱动筛选和系统性筛选的联合调查，将IL-6中的一个非同义单核苷酸多态性（SNP）rs13306435确定为候选研究位点，并在包含241例病例和229名健康受试者的扩展队列中通过HRM基因分型进一步验证。使用Western blotting和qRT-PCR评估该变异对晶体诱导炎症的影响，同时采用分子动力学模拟分析受体结合复合物的结构变化。在年龄≤40岁的个体中，rs13306435的A等位基因名义上与结石形成风险降低相关，但在总体人群中未观察到关联。该错义变异导致天冬氨酸到谷氨酸的替换（D/E），抑制草酸钙一水合物（COM）触发的JAK2/STAT3激活和炎症反应。然而，它通过增加远端界面的氢键和盐桥降低了IL-6/IL-6R/gp130复合物的结合能，表明增强的受体结合不一定转化为增强的下游信号传导。尽管该变异与一般结石易感性无关，但它通过减弱COM诱导的JAK2/STAT3激活表现出显著抗炎活性，并可能通过该途径影响结石的进展。这些发现为抗炎机制在肾结石中的作用提供了新见解。
